description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples for the RecognizeAction operation
description_zh: 本文介绍动作行为识别RecognizeAction的语法及示例
name: RecognizeAction

parameters.help_en:
The input content type, which can be video or image.

0: indicates a video URL or Base64-encoded video string.

1: indicates an image URL or Base64-encoded image string.

Other values: invalid input
parameters.help_zh:
输入内容类型，包括视频和图像两种类型。

0：表示输入视频URL或视频Base64编码字符串。

1：表示输入图像URL或图像Base64编码字符串。

其他：非法输入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The video URL to input when Type is set to 0. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: Type为0时需要输入的视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

element_fields.help_en: The image URL to input when Type is set to 1. You must input exactly 4 images, and the 4 images should be uniformly sampled from a 2-second video. The resolution and number of channels must be consistent. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
element_fields.help_zh: Type为1时需要输入的图像URL地址，必须输入4张图像，且4张图像建议为两秒钟视频均匀采样的图像，分辨率和通道数必须一致。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
element_fields.name: url

element_fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded image string. When both this parameter and URL are specified, URL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
element_fields.help_zh: 图像Base64编码字符串，与URL共存时，URL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
element_fields.name: image_data

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded video string. When both this parameter and VideoURL are specified, VideoURL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频Base64编码字符串，与VideoURL共存时，VideoURL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: video_data
